pr2.qualification: Not merely a YAML patch or formatting-only change; prior green checks are not final acceptance.

sourceBaseline.recommendation: Explicitly incorporate PR2's useful quality and v2 review foundation into the isolated Work branch, preserve original commit provenance, fix all four findings and remove review-arrival machinery before independent candidate review. Do not merge PR2 as-is or rebuild the entire quality system from main's weaker legacy gate.
sourceBaseline.scope: Common source only. Existing PR2 native-package content is a reviewed source-baseline import, not permission for additional runtime-specific changes or activation. Preserve current live checkouts, public legacy interfaces and immutable releases.

whyNotMainAlone.problem: Main only accepts v1 provenance.owner=hermes-harness-engineering. Relabeling this Codex-owned common review as Hermes would be untruthful.
whyNotMainAlone.retainedSolution: PR2 v2 binds codeOwner=agent-platform, evidenceOwner=codex-harness-engineering, independent native identities, exact head/tree/full source manifest and immutable result bytes. Preserve legacy v1 semantics for historical consumers.
whyNotMainAlone.noTrustWeakening: Do not synthesize success from a GitHub account comment, drop publisher/manifest checks, or equate source verification with runtime/user acceptance.

requiredCorrections.change: Run combination-sensitive architecture/quality validation against the prospective merge checkout, after exact dependency preparation, in addition to existing source-check. Head checks remain separate.
requiredCorrections.negativeProof: Two individually valid head/base changes create an invalid combined ownership/import graph; merge-result validation must reject it.

requiredCorrections.change: Include compatibility implementation sources in lint/format/secret/currentness denominators and verify they are canonical forwarding adapters. Govern new files too.
requiredCorrections.negativeProof: Adding a maintained implementation/import outside canonical ownership in compatibility/src must fail, while the unchanged legal forwarder passes.

requiredCorrections.change: Build Ontology outputs in a disposable copy/output and compare the declared generated-output tree to reviewed committed bytes; reject missing/extra/stale outputs. Preserve original checkout bytes and bind generated evidence explicitly.
requiredCorrections.negativeProof: Change committed dist without matching source/generator output; verification must fail before a build silently repairs reviewed input. Original checkout remains unchanged.

requiredCorrections.change: Select maintained tracked documentation, including README.md/AGENTS.md and maintained package docs, for the secret denominator. Keep explicit exclusions for immutable history/releases, evidence/private data and generated content.
requiredCorrections.negativeProof: Synthetic credential in maintained Markdown is detected without persisting the credential in reports; excluded private/history bodies are not admitted.

observerAblation.decision: Remove observer and availability probe; retain the named trusted receipt-validation job.
observerAblation.earlier384Qualification: 384 was the conditional removal of observer plus the entire51-line native-review job. The actual required-context rules make preserving a minimal validation job the safer plan.
retain: Exact head native independent review job name
Source and native review gate name and required semantics
observerAblation.replacement: Explicit native Lead publication order, plus a targeted explicit rerun if post-merge status arrival races. No new observer, poller, reviewer dispatcher, runtime or auto-merge.

liveRepositoryReadback.transport: Official gh2.86.0 used because currently exposed provider MCP lacks variable/ruleset/status-write operations; provider get_me was called first.
liveRepositoryReadback.legacyBranchProtection: 404 Branch not protected; active ruleset independently observed, so404 is not evidence of no enforcement.
liveRepositoryReadback.implications: No extra human/account approval is invented. Preserve effective rule names, current threads and native independent proof. Only explicit Lead merge is allowed; existing auto-merge=false needs no settings change.
liveRepositoryReadback.proofLimits: Readback proves visible configuration and identity at this time, not all bypass actors, trust of arbitrary shared credentials, or successful future publication.

publicationSequence.action: Integrate source baseline/fixes/common implementation in the isolated Work branch. Admit only required common types/validators/exports and meaningful negative tests; do not import the historical Memory bridge merely to obtain LogicalIdentity/TaskOperationalState.

Run appropriate common source/quality/compatibility/immutable-output and new-feature checks, including four counterexamples above. Preserve finite owner/first-import/resolved-module checks. No live owner registration/config/runtime refresh.

Commit and freeze the final candidate. Independent native reviewer verifies exact commit/tree, complete source scope and current findings. Any subsequent source-tree change requires renewed review; do not modify reviewed source to append review output.

Push source and independently read back exact remote head/tree. Publish original independent result bytes to a separate evidence commit R, then a receipt commit Q referencing immutable R. Neither is the source head; preserve true author/reviewer identities and original result bytes.

Publish native-independent-review success through existing authenticated native GitHub CLI only after receipt/result verification. Target the immutable receipt at Q; publisher identity must match repository variables. Use provider MCP for operations it actually exposes; add no custom client.

Open the new/replacement PR only after the exact head status exists. This lets the minimal native-review job pass without arrival polling. Explain PR2 provenance and four fixes; do not claim old PR2 discussion flags were remotely resolved. PR2 remains unmerged.

Wait for head source/quality, prospective merge validation, immutable review validation and final gate. Lead re-reads current head/base, effective rules/checks and unresolved candidate findings. A base/source change requires relevant re-verification/review.

Accountable Lead explicitly merges using the maintained native MCP with expected head SHA and merge_method=merge. No auto-merge enablement, queue, merge bot, or human-per-merge gate beyond actual policy.

Read the resulting main commit/tree. Merge creates a new SHA; an old exact-head receipt is not automatically valid. If tree equality/current review state/no unresolved findings hold, obtain a minimal independent reviewer successor attestation binding the original immutable result to new main, then publish a new immutable result/receipt/status for that exact main SHA. Preserve original proof and explicit reuse relationship.

If the push-main review job ran before the new exact status, explicitly rerun only that job and dependent gate through the existing native interface. Reuse successful source/quality jobs. Never fabricate green status or reintroduce an automatic observer.

Verify main workflow bytes, completed exact-main checks and source/tree identity. Hand off the completed common source SHA to WSL2/VPS Leads for their separately owned improvements/activation. Common source completion is distinct from runtime adoption and User AcceptanceDecision.

sameTreeReuseCompatibility.existingValidator: v2 validates exact fields/result provenance but does not validate a same-tree successor relationship by itself.
sameTreeReuseCompatibility.minimalSafeRoute: A native independent reviewer explicitly verifies the new main binding using prior reviewed-tree evidence and current review state. Publish its truthful new exact-main result with immutable prior-proof references, rather than rewriting old evidence or simply substituting a head SHA.
sameTreeReuseCompatibility.ifTreeChanged: Fresh independent source review is required. Do not claim tree equality for a merge whose tested base changed.
sameTreeReuseCompatibility.noNewProtocolRequired: Prefer the existing exact-head trusted result/receipt contract and a small independently attributed follow-up. A broader reusable successor-receipt schema can remain separate if not needed for this completion.

commonAdmission.minimalPromotion: Expose only shared LogicalIdentity/TaskOperationalState validation needed by the common Git API; preserve semantic ownership and acyclic dependency direction.
commonAdmission.excluded: Per-runtime hooks/providers/session/schedulers, runtime rollout, old CAS/Memory migrations, native configuration/trust, protected Wiki and paused Hermes Work.
commonAdmission.tests: New code must enter existing source/quality/test/architecture denominators. Keep generated/candidate/staged scope explicit; do not hide new implementation under an exclusion.
commonAdmission.recordOwnership: Work/decisions/code/verification references belong to the same Work branch. Review receipts live in immutable evidence commits to avoid self-referential source hashes. No separate decision-publication lane.

acceptanceCriteria: All four source findings closed by meaningful negative cases
Quality/head and merge-result source identities explicit
Exact independent result/receipt/status published before PR
Explicit Lead merge of expected head
New main exact binding and checks verified
Runtime-Lead handoff pins final main without activation claims

rootOwnedSourcePartition.meaningfulTests: Root owns CI/quality regression tests for the four findings and review publication changes.
rootOwnedSourcePartition.commonFeatureBoundary: Small git-work API, minimal neutral state validators, documentation-only sharedRuntimeIndex and actual Work records; exact new paths assigned by Root finalPlan before bounded implementation tasks.
rootOwnedSourcePartition.runtimeBoundary: Old runtime APIs remain compatible. No live WSL2/Hermes registration refresh, Hook/provider/config change or activation. Imported PR2 source baseline preserves its provenance; additional runtime improvements are deferred.

publisherCLI.preconditions: Actual independent pass/zero unresolved findings; immutable result R and receipt Q re-read; source head/tree/manifest/publisher exact. Never use this command as a substitute for review.
publisherCLI.nativePreference: Use maintained MCP for merge and any exposed rerun/file/ref operation; official gh CLI is the existing fallback for missing status publication. No custom observer/client.

mergeParentPreservation.preference: Preserve PR2 original commit ancestry when Root selects a reviewed local source import, or retain an exact imported-source manifest/provenance if selective import is chosen. Root chooses after final Plan review; no mutation has occurred.
mergeParentPreservation.expectedResult: GitHub merge preserves current main and reviewed candidate as parents. Verify returned new main tree explicitly; commit identity changes even if the tree is identical.
mergeParentPreservation.forbidden: Do not remotely merge PR2 as-is, enable auto-merge or silently change parent/source identity.
